t: This is the home of the BBC, the British Broadcasting Corporation, headquartered at Broadcasting House in London. It began in 1922 as the British Broadcasting Company and took its present name on the first of January 1927. John Reith ran it from the start, first as general manager, then managing director, and from 1927 as Director-General. He set the tradition of independent public service broadcasting, and saw it as a way of educating the masses. The Earl of Clarendon is also counted among its founders. Today the BBC has around twenty-two thousand staff.
